from pathlib import Path
import os,sys,json,subprocess,time,hashlib,urllib.parse
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
r=root/'.local/step07-review/independent-round11'; own=json.loads((root/'.local/postgres/ownership.json').read_text())
assert own['root']==str(root)+'/' and own['port']==55501
assert (root/'.env').stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o600
env=os.environ.copy(); env['PATH']='/Users/dingshinn/.nvm/versions/node/v22.21.1/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@14/bin:'+env['PATH']
for line in (root/'.env').read_text().splitlines():
 if '=' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
  k,v=line.split('=',1); env[k]=v
assert urllib.parse.urlsplit(env['DATABASE_URL']).port==55501
assert env['API_PORT']=='4401' and env['WEB_PORT']=='5301'
env.update({'INTEGRATION_API_PORT':'4401','STEP07_TEST_API_PORT':'4401','TILESET_PG_BIN':'/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@14/bin','TILESET_ASSET_ROOT':'.local/step07-review/assets'})
label=sys.argv[1]; cmd=sys.argv[2:];
if label=='lifecycle-empty-browser':
 cache=r/'private'/'empty-chromium-cache'; cache.mkdir(exist_ok=False); env['PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH']=str(cache)
 (r/'evidence/empty-browser-start.json').write_text(json.dumps({'cacheInitiallyAbsent':True,'filesAfterCreation':len(list(cache.iterdir())),'path':str(cache.relative_to(r))},indent=2)+'\n')
start=time.time(); raw=r/'private'/f'{label}.raw.log'; log=r/'evidence'/f'{label}.log.txt'
with raw.open('wb') as f:
 p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
 (r/'private'/f'{label}.pid.json').write_text(json.dumps({'pid':p.pid,'cmd':cmd,'cwd':str(root)}))
 code=p.wait()
b=raw.read_bytes(); secret=own['password'].encode(); safe=b.replace(env['DATABASE_URL'].encode(),b'[REDACTED_OWN_DSN]').replace(secret,b'[REDACTED_OWN_PASSWORD]')
log.write_bytes(safe)
res={'label':label,'cmd':cmd,'source':'dc61fe03f64e644b7ac63057b3f7d7d26df547f8','exitCode':code,'seconds':round(time.time()-start,3),'log':str(log.relative_to(r)),'logSHA':hashlib.sha256(safe).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(safe),'rawSHA':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'rawBytes':len(b),'redactions':b.count(secret)}
(r/'evidence'/f'{label}.result.json').write_text(json.dumps(res,indent=2)+'\n'); print(json.dumps(res))
